newsitem.title: USA: Koll to make bid for Santa Anita - WSJ.
newsitem.headline: Koll to make bid for Santa Anita - WSJ.

text.p: U.S. Koll Real Estate Group and Apollo Real Estate Advisors plan to make a counter bid for Santa Anita Cos worth about $180 million on Wednesday, the Wall Street Journal reported.
Citing people close to the deal, the newspaper said in its Wednesday edition that the counter bid would offer a $14 a share cash dividend to shareholders for a 55-percent stake.
Koll already owns 5.0 percent in Santa Anita, it added.
Santa Anita's board of directors had agreed last August to sell a 45-percent stake to real estate investment firm, Colony Capital, the newspaper said.
Although the deal was worth about $15 a share, shareholders were not to get any cash, it said.
Some shareholders had criticized the deal with Colony, it said.
